_status: FROZEN 2026-10-05 - method of record. Do not change values without a new dated decision; any change invalidates results produced under the previous config_sha256.

domain_orientation._why: Clause security_domains -> orientation. A unit takes the orientation that appears most often among its clause's domains; ties go to the first listed.

control_orientation._why: Control-level overrides, checked BEFORE family_orientation. Needed because a family can mix technical and privacy controls (SI holds si-12/si-18/si-19). Lookup order: exact control id, then its base control (si-12.1 -> si-12), then the family.

level_match._why: Expected catalog implementation-level per orientation. A mismatch multiplies the cell by level_mismatch_factor.

_compatibility_why: Symmetric by design: whether a duty and a control are the same TYPE does not depend on which side you start from. Three previously asymmetric pairs (technical-procedural, technical-governance, technical-data_governance) were set to the LOWER value (cautious: less credit for a type mismatch). None of the 37 FleetTrack pairs uses the changed cells, so the choice was not results-driven.
